rows.value: Zero-rated (0%): exports, stores for ships, aircraft and fishing vessels leaving Kiribati, services used outside Kiribati, international transport, transfers of a going concern, fishing licences used mainly for fish exports, and bus, truck and taxi passenger transport (other than by tour operators)

source.title: Value Added Tax (VAT) and Excise: exemptions and zero-rated items (August 2024)

rows.label: VAT exemptions
rows.value: Exempt: uncooked rice and wheat flour, kerosene, bicycles, mosquito nets, exercise books, financial services, residential rents and sales (not new premises), unimproved land, education, medical services and pharmacy-only medicine, and services of state-owned enterprises and island councils
rows.note: The source gives no start date for this figure; stored from the start of the 2026 tax year (calendar year). The 2026 Budget Speech says the VAT (Amendment) Act removes the VAT exemptions of state-owned enterprises; the list as published (August 2024) still shows them.
